digest.component_or_area: acceptance criteria tagging and plan-review verification
propositions: The tag `[operator-attested]` mis-signals intent by naming the attestor (who) rather than evidence location (where), and must be renamed to `[non-codebase]` to clarify that attested evidence exists outside the codebase

The canonical regex matcher and `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` activation trigger must accept both `[non-codebase]` and `[operator-attested]` (case-insensitive) as a non-capturing alternation to maintain backwards compatibility for 827 immutable event-sourced tickets

The deterministic matcher, LLM-emitted classifications, prompts, and wire-value schema must be cut over in lockstep so that legacy `kind: "operator-attested"` verdicts render identically to new `kind: "non-codebase"` ones
Author-facing documentation and generated guides must emit `[non-codebase]` only; `[operator-attested]` must not appear in any documented surface
The widened regex alternation must be non-capturing to preserve `findall()` arity across five consumer sites that share the compiled regex object

Contract text line-count selectors, message templates, coach output, and digest pins must all be updated atomically in a single commit to preserve test assertions on exact string matches and contract counts
